rows.scene: The guild hall at midday: a crowded common room, a crackling hearth, and a job board covered in parchment.
A stone sphinx guards a golden, half-buried gate in the desert; the party stands before the ancient ruins.
The party flees through a medieval market street at night, lanterns swinging above the shuttered stalls.
Dawn over a still mountain lake; the party breaks camp on the shore.
A moonlit beach; waves wash over the sand as two figures walk along the shoreline.
An audience with the queen in her gilded throne room.
A quiet room at the inn: a bed, a washstand, and a small window over the street.
The survivors pick through the ruins of a collapsed city, rusted cars and broken towers all around.
A cabin on a frozen lake in deep winter, smoke rising from the chimney.
A cramped neon-lit apartment high above a rainy megacity, holograms flickering over the bed.
The reactor room of a salvage spaceship: warning lights, coolant pipes, and a flickering containment field.
A 1940s police precinct at three in the morning: cold coffee, ringing phones, rain on the windows.

compose.objective: Pick up a contract at the guild.

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: Drinkers crowd the long tables and the hearth roars.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: I push through to the job board.

compose.objective: Answer the riddle and enter the ruins.

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: A half-buried golden gate rises from the dunes, a stone sphinx crouched before it.

messages.speaker: Arin
messages.text: "Well. There it is."

compose.objective: Find the fence before the watch does.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text: Lanterns sway over shuttered stalls on the old market street.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: I keep to the shadows between the stalls.

messages.speaker: DM Narrator
messages.text: Mist lifts off a still mountain lake as the party rolls up their bedrolls.

messages.speaker: Luke
messages.text: "The water's freezing!"

compose.objective: Convince the queen to lend her guard.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text: Gilded columns line the hall; the queen watches from her throne.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: I bow low before the dais.

messages.speaker: HALO
messages.text: "Coolant pressure falling. Containment at forty percent."

messages.speaker: Pell
messages.text: Pell slams the manual override.

compose.objective: Pasar la noche a salvo de la tormenta de nieve.

messages.speaker: Narrador
messages.text: Una cabaña solitaria sobre el lago helado; sale humo de la chimenea.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: Llamo a la puerta con los guantes cubiertos de nieve.

compose.objective: Encontrar agua potable entre los escombros.

messages.speaker: Narrador
messages.text: Coches oxidados y torres partidas por la mitad llenan la avenida muerta.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: Reviso cada coche buscando botellas.

compose.objective: Leer el expediente antes de que vuelva el teniente.

messages.speaker: Narrador
messages.text: Tres de la mañana en la comisaría: café frío, teléfonos que suenan, lluvia contra el cristal.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: Abro el cajón del archivador.

compose.objective: Find your seat before the bell.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text: Sunlight slants across rows of desks; the teacher writes the date on the board.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: I slide into the empty desk by the window.
